role: A container window click: window id, slot, button, click mode (pickup/quick-move/swap etc.) and the client's predicted cursor stack.

members.name: field_149554_a (window id)
members.note: the act's click rows carry (window, slot, button, mode); survival.h's client_out notes the C0E the client mirror queues

members.name: field_149550_d (transaction id)
members.note: pairs with the S32 confirm, which changes nothing the rows read (survival.c:4497)

members.name: field_149551_e (predicted stack)
members.note: the server ignores it in vanilla (used only by the creative check); the native server applies its own container state

members.name: C0EPacketClickWindow
members.note: the act's click rows are applied by surv_client_click (PlayerControllerMP.windowClick's client half) and forwarded to surv_server_click in the same tick

members.name: readPacketData
members.note: wire framing; the native engine has no network

members.name: processPacket
members.note: processClickWindow's server half over the open container, then the S2F slots detectAndSendChanges queues

members.name: C0EPacketClickWindow
members.note: the decoder's ctor only: Packet.generatePacket instantiates it by reflection (newInstance) for bytes read off a socket (MessageDeserializer); the integrated server's local channel passes packet objects with no codec (NetworkManager.provideLocalClient adds only the packet_handler), so it never runs

notes: container.c holds the actual click machine (pickup, quick-move, swap, the craft-result useRecipe path); survival.c only dispatches and mirrors.
